meta.title: Hanmo
meta.description: Restyles the DSH sidebar and main panel: cyan-glow outlined tiles, a comet trace on New Session, a glass composer, and a selection that slides between rows on a spring. Adds six VS Code colour themes plus sunset, sunrise, deep-sea (with sunlit water and rising bubbles), beach and afterglow sky themes, a 天色 (Daylight) theme that follows the real sky over your city, a time-of-day switch for every sky, a gradient-sky scope switch for the sidebar and the main panel, your own wallpaper (main panel only, or across the whole window), font, size and text-colour controls in the session header, and a highlighted file preview tab.
